secondary.$description: Solid fill. Bind layer opacity to opacity/600 where this is used. Previously baked as #ffffff @60%.

disabled.$description: Solid fill. Bind layer opacity to opacity/400 where this is used. Previously baked as #ffffff @40%.

overlay.$description: Solid fill. Bind layer opacity to opacity/400 where this is used. Previously baked as #111111 @40%.

ghost.$description: Solid fill. Bind layer opacity to opacity/100 where this is used. Previously baked as #111111 @10%.

subtle.$description: Solid fill. Bind layer opacity to opacity/200 where this is used. Previously baked as #ffffff @20%.
